text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Meteorite~~~ FAAAALLL!!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And it hits yet again! Team 'Five Stars' 
with their special move!! 
Team 'Carrots Are a Beverage' is 
completely helpless against it—!!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text:
Game set! 
With a score of 26 to 12, Team 'Five 
Stars' advances to the finals!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, two consecutive wins, 
incredible!! 
Could we actually go all the way and win 
the finals too...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! With that 'Special Move' of 
ours, 
victory is practically guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Considering our team's overall stats, our 
performance thus far is deemed reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but the finals will be the greatest 
challenge. 
In racing terms, it's the fierce duel down 
the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
And—the ones who will emerge victorious 
from that fierce duel 
shall be us, Team 'Penta'!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt your break. Though 
honestly, 
back then I never imagined you'd actually 
make it to the finals.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to playing against Penta 
before! 
In this final match, we'll show you how 
much we've grown♪

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I've seen plenty of that already. 
Which is exactly why... I'm looking 
forward to the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text:
And now, the final match between Team Five 
Stars 
and Team Penta is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's score first and take the momentum! 
Tannhauser-chan, go!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Team Five Stars is setting up rapid 
passes right from the start! 
The ball goes to their Demon General, 
could this be—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nice pass! Machitan ATTACK!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—or so you thought~! 
Bakushin O-san, take it away!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's a fake! 
And from that posture, could Team Five 
Stars' special move be coming?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! 
Special move: Meteorite FALLLLL!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text: Too naive! CAUGHT IT!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What...?! Our special killer move, 
the Meteorite Fall, was caught?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! S-She caught it...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, everyone! 
It's okay, the game has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...She is right. 
Everyone, fall into defensive formation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, why, why...?! None of our special 
moves 
are landing at all...!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
What's going on...? What happened to Five 
Stars? 
They can't seem to score a single point...

text_block_list.name: Cheering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And the team's momentum 
is rapidly fading, too...

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Wondering why none of your special moves 
are landing? 
Well, the reason is simple.

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
You showed off your moves way too much in 
the earlier matches. 
Thanks to that, we were able to thoroughly 
prep our counters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I... I do not mind! Keep passing the 
ball... to me! 
As your Class Rep... I shall turn this 
around... in no time...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself, Baku-chan! 
You've been constantly attacking, so 
you're the one most drained of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Even so, if this keeps going... Grrrrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Well, this was pretty entertaining, but 
it's about time you gave up!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the ones who come out on top 
are us—

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text:
That's the end of the first half! We will 
now enter a 10-minute halftime break!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text: Haha, saved by the bell, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Twelve to zero... is it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The reason our special move is not 
working 
is likely that Bakushin O-san's movements 
are being read.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! 
They can read the movements of me, the 
Class Rep...?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The core of the Meteorite Fall relies 
on Bakushin O-san 
jumping high into the air to unleash an 
attack from above.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...However, because your movements are 
being anticipated, 
the run-up necessary for that high jump is 
being shut down.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A jump and attack stripped of their 
momentum lose half their power— 
which is practically the same as passing 
the ball directly to the opponent.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then instead of special moves, what if we 
just use normal attacks...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No. In the first place, we developed 
that special move 
to bridge the gap in experience between us 
and Penta. A standard approach will not 
work against them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is a failure of tactical judgment on 
my part for relying on a single special 
move. 
If only I had taken measures, such as 
concealing the move until the finals...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ikuno-chan...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay, we can do this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it matters if we can't use 
our 'special move.' 
Ikuno talked about a gap in experience, 
but we've gained plenty of experience 
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno, you put so much thought into 
creating our training regimens, right? 
Thanks to that, I know our regular attacks 
have improved a whole lot too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I agree! We can still do this even without 
our special move! 
If we can't land a hit, we just have to 
keep throwing until we do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to give up either! I 
originally joined because 
it reminded me of games I couldn't join 
when I was little, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Spending time together helped me get to 
know everyone so well. 
And now I know we can believe in each 
other and support one another!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The probability of success in 'Struggle 
Mode' may be low. 
However, I am certain it is by no means 
'worthless.'

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. Freezing up and shutting down 
at a time like this... I am deeply 
ashamed. 
No beautiful scenery can ever be found by 
giving up and walking away...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize! Ikuno's been 
encouraging me 
this entire time, after all. More 
importantly, let's see this through 
together to the very end, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! Baku-chan, let's swap out the 
Demon General. 
I'll join the offense too so it reduces 
your burden.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will switch as well. 
Laurel-san and I have 
been coordinating passes all along, so our 
teamwork should remain smooth even with me 
as Demon General.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us show them the strength of our bond! 
We shall Bakushin with all our might and 
blow the opposition away!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Bonds... Yes, indeed, we...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(We have come to trust one another far 
beyond our initial expectations. 
Another weapon, stronger than before... 
Could it be that now—?)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I believe I have found a 
breakthrough...!
